text:
Marco: quick sync — trying to land a small chain of PRs that cross SDK + API + Console + Helm/runtime. putting the merge order proposal here so we don't stomp each other.

Marco: PRs: api#1245 (auth header opt-in), sdk#678 (client bump), console#891 (ui toggle), runtime#402 (token cache fix), helm#312 (image + chart bump).

Marco: proposed order: runtime#402 -> helm#312 (chart images) -> api#1245 -> sdk#678 -> console#891. runtime change is lowest-level and affects behavior of api. helm needs runtime image tag.

Marco: requested reviewers: @Sylvia for runtime, @Raj for helm, @Emma for api, @Leila for SDK. Can people ack and call blockers? :eyes:

Sylvia: ack — I can review runtime#402 today. quick note: I added a config toggle so we can roll back without redeploying infra.

Raj: saw helm#312, looks straightforward. will validate chart lint + k8s api versions. will need the runtime image tag from runtime CI — can we publish a canary tag?

Marco: yes, runtime CI publishes `canary-{{sha:8}}`. Sylvia, can you trigger a canary build after you approve?

Sylvia: yep. I'll push a canary tag once tests pass. ETA ~1h.

Emma: flagged one compat concern on api#1245 — the optional auth header name change needs to be backwards compatible for older SDKs. left a tiny comment inline.

Leila: sdk#678 depends on api#1245 behavior. I can fast-follow once api is merged. if api adds feature flag, we should gate SDK usage behind feature detection.

QA-Bot: smoke-tests queued for runtime canary -> helm staging deploy. Will run the basic auth and KV cache tests.

Raj: after canary tag available I'll update helm#312 values.yaml: `image.tag: canary-<sha>` and run `helm lint` then create a staging deploy job.

Marco: merging windows — we should avoid pushing to prod between 10:00-12:00 PT tomorrow due to other scheduled deploys. Prefer merge chain at 13:00 PT midday slot.

Sylvia: agreed. I'll target runtime merge + canary at 11:00 PT, QA can run, then we can promote at 13:00 PT assuming green.

Emma: I'll finish api review now. if it's small I can approve within 30m.

Leila: I'll queue SDK CI but won't merge until api#1245 is in. I have a test that fails on older header names, so will run compatibility suite once api merged.

Raj: one more note — helm#312 also updates a CRD minor field. I've left a compat note in the PR; runtime change shouldn't affect that but wanted to surface for SRE. @SRE FYI.

Marco: thanks. action items: Sylvia triggers canary after approval; Raj updates helm to canary tag and lints; Emma merges api after Sylvia canary pass; Leila merges SDK after api; Raj + Marco merge helm then console.

Sylvia: rolling. will ping here with canary sha and test results.

deploy-bot: CI status — runtime#402: tests passed (branch tests), build published as `canary-9f3b4a2e`, helm#312: lint pending, api#1245: tests running, sdk#678: tests queued.

Marco: perfect — please ping when the canary is verified so we can sequence the rest. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Raj: noted, will wait for the canary sha.

Emma: merging api#1245 in 20m if no further comments.

Leila: standing by to cut sdk#678 once api is merged. I'll post a quick compatibility checklist here when ready.

Sylvia: canary verification: runtime `canary-9f3b4a2e` passed smoke tests (auth, cache, perf baseline). all clear from my side.

Raj: updated helm#312 values to `image.tag: canary-9f3b4a2e` and ran `helm template` locally — no diffs in CRD. pushed changes and re-ran lint; CI passed.

deploy-bot: api#1245 — tests passed.

Emma: merged api#1245. left a release comment.

Leila: SDK CI green. merging sdk#678 now.

Leila: merged sdk#678. published client v1.14.0-rc.

Marco: console#891 has one tiny UX tweak left — @Raj can you give console owner a quick heads-up after helm promotion?

Raj: will do. planning helm promote to staging at 12:50 PT and prod at 13:10 PT if everything stays green.

Marco: thanks all — great coordination. I'll close the loop once prod is live.

deploy-bot: helm#312 promoted to prod at 13:12 PT — rollout healthy. console#891 merged and released 13:20 PT.

Marco: prod confirmed. closing thread. :tada:
